_comment: Generated by scripts/gen_matrix.py. Two tiers, both swept over [16, 64, 256, 1024, 4096, 16384] bytes (the size set the OMQ comparison and monocoque's benches both sweep). Tiers split by PATTERN, never by library: every implementation runs every cell it is capable of. HEADLINE: tcp, the three patterns every implementation here implements (REQ/REP latency, 1-to-1 PUSH/PULL throughput, PUB/SUB at 32 subscribers) -- these are the cross-library charts. EXTENDED: ipc, fan-out and fan-in, for every implementation able to run them (zmq.rs has no fan-out or fan-in: its PUSH/PULL does not multiplex several peers on the bound side). 264 headline + 306 extended = 570 cells. Count-based kinds shrink their message count as the payload grows so cells stay within budget; duration-based kinds run a 3.0s window. Each cell runs in a 4-core cpuset so the producer and consumer do not time-share one core; the numbers still come from a shared host, so treat them as the payload trend and relative shape, not a final absolute verdict. Regenerate with: python3 scripts/gen_matrix.py
